title: Create a Waffle
description: A modpack focused on Create for my good friend Evan
body:
# Yes you can make waffles.
Sometimes a modpack exists purely because editing a premade one is just too hard. This is one of those modpacks!

Heavily focused on Create, there are additional mods that allow players to make pretty things or distract themsevles from that one thing they _really_ should be working on instead.

Go exploring for new and interesting structures, get on that grind with Create, or simply immerse yourself in the kitchen with tons of cooking mods! This pack is designed for a relaxed and cozy gameplay for all persons whether you prefer spelunking or farming. There's also a level of focus on multiplayer aspects so feel free to invite your friends to your world and show them all your cool builds or finds!
